title: Fastf1 Metric5 High Value Outliers
dataSources: FastF1 session data (`fastf1:session`), Ergast race results (`ergast:result`), F1 Fantasy teams (`f1fantasy:team`), race watch parties (`race:watchparty`), and F1 telemetry laps (`f1telemetry:lap`).
app: FastF1 session exports, Ergast race results, F1 Fantasy team snapshots, race watch-party logs, and F1 telemetry lap dumps forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=fastf1:metric5 value=*
| eventstats perc90(value) as p90, perc10(value) as p10
| where value>=p90 OR value<=p10
| table _time source_id value p90 p10
description: Surfaces the highest and lowest value outliers in fastf1 metric5 (5) events.
value: Tail events often explain spikes in cost, effort, or risk that averages hide.
implementation: Compute percentile bands on `value` and review extreme fastf1 metric5 (5) records.
visualization: Scatter plot of value with percentile bands.
grandmaExplanation: It smartly the unusually high or low value moments in your fastf1 metric5 (5) history.
